 YTL Group appoints Yeoh family members to alternate director posts
 TheStar 
 Fri, Oct 23, 2026 03:30pm - 10 hours 
 View Original 
 KUALA LUMPUR: YTL Group has announced the appointment of Joseph Yeoh Keong Shyan as alternate director to Tan Sri Francis Yeoh Sock Ping, in his capacity as executive chairman of Pintar Projek Sdn Bhd, as well as director of YTL Hotels & Properties Sdn Bhd and YTL Land & Development Bhd.
 Joseph Yeoh also serves as an alternate director to Francis Yeoh in Starhill Global Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) Management Ltd in Singapore.
 In a statement, YTL said it has also appointed Yeoh Pei Nee as alternate director to Datuk Yeoh Seok Kian in Starhill Global REIT Management Ltd, while Yeoh Pei Teeng and Yeoh Keong Wei have been appointed directors of YTL Land & Development Bhd. 
 Meanwhile, Yeoh Pei Xien has been appointed director of YTL Hotels & Properties Sdn Bhd and alternate director to Datuk Yeoh Soo Min in Pintar Projek Sdn Bhd. - Bernama 
 ...
 Summary Overview 
 • YTL Group has expanded board representation for the Yeoh family by appointing Joseph Yeoh Keong Shyan as alternate director to executive chairman Tan Sri Francis Yeoh across multiple entities, including Pintar Projek Sdn Bhd and YTL Land & Development Bhd.
• Joseph Yeoh’s role extends to Singapore, where he serves as an alternate director to Francis Yeoh in Starhill Global Real Estate Investment Trust Management Ltd, reinforcing cross-border governance ties.
• Additional family members have been integrated into the leadership structure, with Yeoh Pei Nee appointed as an alternate director in Starhill Global REIT Management Ltd and Yeoh Pei Xien joining YTL Hotels & Properties Sdn Bhd.
• Yeoh Pei Teeng and Yeoh Keong Wei have been newly appointed as directors of YTL Land & Development Bhd, while Yeoh Pei Xien also serves as an alternate director to Datuk Yeoh Soo Min in Pintar Projek Sdn Bhd.
